description: Assembly source code implementing cryptographic functions for BoringSSL, specifically for ARM architecture on Apple platforms, including functions for Galois/Counter Mode (GCM) multiplication and hashing.

methods.name: _gcm_init_v8
methods.description: Initializes the GCM context, loads input H, computes H^2, and stores precomputed tables.

methods.name: _gcm_gmult_v8
methods.description: Performs Galois field multiplication for GCM using ARM NEON instructions.

methods.name: _gcm_ghash_v8
methods.description: Computes GHASH for GCM authentication, processing input data blocks.
